description: This 3D model depicts a modern spiral staircase enclosed within a minimalist glass casing. The staircase itself is made of dark, sleek material, possibly metal or a composite, featuring a central support column and evenly spaced treads. The treads are angled to form a continuous spiral upwards. The glass enclosure is transparent, allowing a clear view of the staircase's structure and the shadows it casts. The base of the structure rests on a tiled platform, creating a sense of a defined space. The overall aesthetic is clean, functional, and contemporary, suggesting a space-saving and visually appealing architectural element.
